on Thursday said it has entered into a Letter of Intent with Nutrien Mineral, a Uganda-based mineral development company, regarding a proposed strategic business combination and reverse merger transaction.

Under the preliminary terms of the LOI, the parties are evaluating a transaction structure whereby NGCG would hold a proposed 51% ownership interest in the agreed transaction structure or combined business vehicle.

As part of the proposed transaction, Nutrien Mineral would receive 5% of the issued and outstanding common shares of NGCG, subject to satisfactory due diligence, valuation review, regulatory compliance, and execution of definitive agreements.

title: New Generation Consumer Group signs LOI for proposed strategic business combination with Nutrien Mineral
